grid.rule: 32x32 is source addressing only; connected artwork is mapped as assemblies, never blindly as standalone world tiles

architecture.worldgen: discrete structural levels -> cardinal exposed-edge mask -> CliffShape15
architecture.visual: CliffShape15 + official ElizaWy demo-grounded component/assembly recipes projected over V7 owner terrain; receiver-side grass is transparent
architecture.perspective: W14 ordinary south walls use exact demo-grounded crest/body/foot families: straight c2r7/c2r3/c2r8, SW c1r7/c1r3/c1r8, SE c3r7/c3r3/c3r8. Crest is host-row presentation; receiver-facing depth equals structural tier delta.
architecture.collision: structural levels + exact runtime recipe footprint are authority; projected collision grows by exactly one row per additional authored middle module; source alpha/color never decide collision
architecture.generatedContourGrammar: fresh PCG is frozen to masks 1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,12 after normalization removes one-cell three/four-edge caps; no fake cap art is generated
architecture.ordinaryCave: one-tile-wide authored c6 r9-r11 mouth independent of cliff height; wide c7-c9 portal is explicit tunnel-only

worldgenShapeBindings.mask4: south: c2r7 host/lip + c2r3 body + c2r8 receiver-transparent foot
worldgenShapeBindings.mask6: east+south: authored SE rounded assembly c3r6,c3r7,c3r3,c3r8
worldgenShapeBindings.mask12: south+west: authored SW rounded assembly c1r6,c1r7,c1r3,c1r8
worldgenShapeBindings.mask15: isolated one-cell plateau; all four boundaries; south face projects below

ramp.placement: explicit semantic MountainPath one-level south connector
ramp.visual: exact complete directional 3x4 ramp stamp from companion LPC grass-top cliff sheet; no transforms or c8 partial crop
ramp.collision: only the center structural edge is opened; six MountainPath approach/departure cells align traversal to the authored diagonal corridor; flanks remain structural-collision owned

stairs.placement: Stairs object on supported south face
stairs.collision: not ordinary walk-through; interaction/transition owns traversal

ladder.placement: ladder state or multi-level stairs attachment
ladder.collision: solid for ordinary walking until climb state drives traversal

cave.collision: mouth wall stays solid; interaction triggers scene transition

waterfall.collision: solid cliff/water boundary; never a walking connector

bridge.collision: walkable crossing corridor only where bridge geometry exists

vines.collision: solid until climb gameplay state is active

assemblies.collision: literal N receiver rows for N structural tiers
literal N receiver rows for N structural tiers; visibility checks west low-side receiver
literal N receiver rows for N structural tiers; visibility checks east low-side receiver

externalResearch.finding: base LPC outdoor assets explicitly include mountains, cliffs, walls, and slopes; cliff art is perspective structure rather than flat terrain paint
recommended workflow is terrain/top outline first, then AutoMap the walls; matches Havenwild two-stage structural-mask then wall-projection architecture
LPC cliffs are asymmetric and extend two extra tiles southward; multi-level generation creates difficult corner cases; south-facing waterfalls are the safest presentation
rule-driven automapping should also create collision; supports one recipe authority for visuals and gameplay footprints
useful cross-check for ElizaWy asset grouping, but its author explicitly notes collision was configured without confidence, so Havenwild does not treat it as collision authority
direct source-template matches prove ordinary south cliffs use c2r7->c2r3->c2r8 and rounded corners use c1/c3 r6->r7->r3->r8; this overrides prior c10/default and three-cell diagonal assumptions
